UI 与核心同语言: One language for UI and core

Fumadocs 从 Markdown／MDX 生成目录、搜索和页面，文档与开源: Fumadocs generates navigation, search and pages from Markdown/MDX. Docs are maintained with the open-source core.
IndexedDB 本地缓存、虚拟消息列表、响应式布局。浏览器作为控制端，不直接: IndexedDB caching, virtual message lists and responsive layouts. The browser controls remote devices rather than accessing local agent processes.
原生端通过 Pion WebRTC 尝试 UDP 数据通道，同时尝试原生 TCP: Native clients use Pion WebRTC for UDP data channels while also attempting native TCP hole punching. Browsers use RTCPeerConnection. Public and optional self-hosted STUN gather candidates in parallel.
客户端只填服务根地址，探测地址从 /p2p/config 下发。可选 Go 探测: Clients need only the service root URL. Probe endpoints come from /p2p/config. The optional Go probe listens on TCP and UDP port 26330.
自建服务提供自己的加密 WebSocket 中继；官方中继受套餐控制。当前不依赖: Self-hosted services provide encrypted WebSocket relay; official relay is plan-controlled. No TURN, DERP or Tunnel dependency is required.
Cloudflare Worker 承载网站、Web 客户端和 /p2p/*。D: Cloudflare Workers host the website, Web client and /p2p/*. Durable Objects coordinate device rooms with hibernating WebSockets; D1 persists device and pairing metadata.
默认 workers.dev 提供 HTTPS；自建无需准备 OAuth、支付或: workers.dev provides HTTPS. Self-hosting requires no OAuth, payment setup or mandatory public VM. Add a probe if your network needs it.
开源连接层不执行商业配额；官方业务层注入身份、计费和服务端权益策略，复用同一连接: The open-source connection layer applies no commercial quotas. The official service injects identity, billing and server-enforced entitlements over the same connection protocol.
原生端使用 SQLite 与附件文件，浏览器使用 IndexedDB 保存配对身: Native clients use SQLite and attachment files. Browsers retain pairing identity and session snapshots in IndexedDB. Reconnect, catch up and resume incremental events.
云端不保存聊天与附件明文；原始项目和 Agent 继续运行在被控电脑上。: The cloud does not store plaintext chats or attachments. Projects and agents keep running on the host computer.
官方 D1 业务层使用 Drizzle ORM；Go 的本地存储和部分 GORM: The official D1 business layer uses Drizzle ORM. Go local storage and remaining GORM paths are separate from the Worker business database.
配对通过 X25519／HKDF／AES-GCM 建立信任，业务通信使用独立方向: Pairing establishes trust with X25519, HKDF and AES-GCM. Direction-specific AEAD keys and replay protection secure traffic. Relayed messages remain end-to-end encrypted.
编号不是凭据: An ID is not a credential
六位设备编号用于发现；首次访问需要被控方确认或验证访问密码。登录同步设备目录，不: Six-digit device IDs enable discovery. First access requires confirmation or password verification. Account directory sync does not automatically trust a new controller.
Better Auth 对接 GitHub／Google，Waffo 对接支付。: Better Auth integrates GitHub/Google; Waffo handles payments. Hosts verify short-lived signed entitlements, so direct connections cannot bypass limits.
UI 用原生视图，核心交给 Go，Web 使用浏览器标准能力。每一层都有清楚的职: Native views for UI, Go for the core and browser standards for Web. Each layer has a clear role and keeps runtime and deployment overhead small.

比较 Reign 官方免费、付费与开源自建方案，了解设备额度、Agent 产品和: Compare Reign's official free, paid and open-source self-hosted options, including device limits, agent products and relay access.
Free 和 Pro 的区别是什么？: What is the difference between Free and Pro?
官方免费方案侧重设备同步与直连，付费方案可提供更多设备额度和官方中继。上方数值、: The official free plan focuses on device sync and direct connections. Paid plans can add device capacity and official relay. Limits, prices and purchase availability above come from the current service; unavailable plans cannot be purchased.
设备与 Agent 怎么计数？: How are devices and agents counted?
额度按被控电脑计算，手机和浏览器控制端不占电脑名额。Codex App 与 CL: Quotas count host computers, not controller phones or browsers. Codex App and CLI count as one Codex product. Product quotas do not mean every provider is integrated; see the support docs.
免费直连失败了怎么办？: What if a free direct connection fails?
官方免费方案不提供官方业务中继，因此有些网络下可能无法连接。可以使用开放后的付费: The official free plan does not include official traffic relay, so some networks may not connect. Use paid relay when available or deploy the open-source Worker with your own encrypted relay.
开源软件不收订阅费，也不执行官方商业配额；但 Cloudflare Worker: The open-source software has no subscription fee or official commercial quotas. Cloudflare Workers, DO, D1 and probe servers remain subject to your infrastructure quotas and billing.
包含 Codex 或其他模型费用吗？: Are Codex or other model costs included?
不包含。你需要自行安装 Agent、登录模型账号，并承担对应模型服务或 API: No. Install your agents, sign into your model accounts and pay the relevant model or API provider. Reign connects devices and controls sessions; it does not provide model compute.
订阅后会改变本地 Agent 的权限吗？: Does a subscription change my agent permissions?
不会替你自动批准 Agent 的工具请求，也不会把本地 Agent 变成云托管。: It does not automatically approve tools or move agents into the cloud. Service entitlements govern remote access and resource limits. Your agent's own permissions and approvals still apply.
用官方服务省去部署，也可以拥有自己的连接服务。你使用的 Agent、模型账号与本: Use the official service or run your own. Your agents, model accounts and local projects stay under your control.
不变的是你的数据边界。: Your data boundaries stay the same.
无论官方还是自建，会话与附件都使用端到端加密。中继只改变网络路径，不改变谁能读取: Official and self-hosted connections both use end-to-end encryption for sessions and attachments. Relay changes the network path, not who can read your conversations.
目前提供 Codex App 和 CLI Provider。套餐中的 Agent: Codex App and CLI providers are available today. Agent counts in plans are product quotas; additional providers need integration before they can be used.
